previous.text_sample: AI Agent explained Updated 23 days ago AI Agent helps your shoppers browse, buy, and get support automatically and in your brand's voice, so your team can focus on the conversations where they're needed most. You get a dedicated AI Agent for each Shopify store you connect. It works across email, chat, SMS, and social media channels, helping new shoppers find products and resolving post-purchase questions like returns, order changes, and shipping updates. You shape what AI Agent does by giving it knowledge about your store, skills for the conversations you want it to handle, a tone of voice that matches your brand, and actions that let it make changes in your connected tools. This article explains what AI Agent is and what it includes.
